codegraph._env: Fail-closed boundary (plan 2026-09-23 §4): a PreToolUse hook FAILS OPEN on its own timeout/launch failure, so freshness cannot be enforced from a hook — scripts/mcp/server-codegraph.mjs proxies the real `codegraph serve --mcp` and answers typed UNKNOWN (isError) whenever index freshness is unproven. CODEGRAPH_MCP_TOOLS re-enables the seven tools the MCP server hides by default (it lists only `explore`); the boundary inherits it. NOTE: `codegraph install` REWRITES this file and restores the raw `codegraph serve --mcp` entry (dropping this boundary, the env block and the guard) — verified twice (2026-08-26, 2026-09-07). Re-apply this whole entry after any `codegraph install`, then re-run `node scripts/mcp-enable.mjs --verify`.
